disposition_reason: 240 raw chicken muscle samples bought in four southern Nigerian cities were analysed by graphite-furnace AAS for Pb, Cr, Cd, Mn, Ni, Zn and Cu; Table 1 prints range and mean ± SE per city.

study.design: market survey, 60 samples per city, sampled quarterly
study.market: major open markets in Warri, Akure, Ado-Ekiti and Benin City, southern Nigeria
study.method: washed, oven-dried at 40 C, HNO3/HClO4/H2O2 (10:1:2) digestion at 150 C, graphite-furnace AAS (GBS SensAAS 1175)
study.qa: reagent blanks only; no CRM or recovery reported

unresolved: Table 2 gives a summed 'mean heavy metal' per city (e.g. Warri 5.701 ± 0.150 mg/kg) across all seven metals; not an analyte-specific concentration, not recorded.
Akure cadmium mean (0.005 mg/kg) is below its printed range (0.010-0.011 mg/kg).
Results are stated as mg/kg wet weight even though samples were oven-dried before digestion; no moisture correction is described.
Some SE values (e.g. Zn Ado-Ekiti ± 0.101 on a mean of 0.117 with range 0.101-0.123) are inconsistent with the ranges; kept as printed in notes.
Table 3 EDI values are higher than plausible from these concentrations (units mg/kg/day); not used.
